periodicity: N=67 p=10 q=19   (v_{n+p} = v_n + q for all n >= N)
p*gamma - q*n for n = N .. N+p-1: 17 18 9 10 11 12 13 14 15 16
so gamma(n) = ceil((19 n + 9) / 10) for all n >= N; exceptions below N: 1(+1) 4(-1) 7(-1) 8(-1) 15(-1) 18(-1) 26(-1) 37(-1) 48(-1)
